board.empty: No project yet — link a project to see its board.
board.agent.hint: Describe the work in one box — the agent you assign writes the proper title and description itself. Queues to backlog by default; hit Dispatch to start it right away.
board.agent.queuedDone: Queued "{title}" — the agent spawns when it is pulled out of backlog
board.agent.msgAssign: You are assigned work item {id} on the project board: "{title}".
board.agent.msgDone: First refine the item: rewrite its title and description properly via team_item_update (title max ~140 chars; when the item is about a specific GitHub issue/PR, title it "#<n>_IS: <short desc>" for an issue or "#<n>_PR: <short desc>" for a pull request). Read the full context with team_item_get. When done, set status in_review.
board.agent.attachHead: Attachments (read them with the Read tool):
board.title: Issues
board.tagline: The shared backlog across all your projects.
board.agent.briefPh: What needs doing? e.g. "Harden the login flow — refresh tokens silently expire and users get kicked to the sign-in screen."
board.ai.briefPh: Describe the item in one or two lines — AI fills title + description…
board.bulk.deleteDesc: Delete {n} item(s)? This cannot be undone.
board.adv.title: Advanced
board.adv.hint: Per-assignee runtime overrides — applied to the session that runs this item. Empty = inherit the agent/session defaults.
board.adv.optimizeTitle: Pick the cheapest capable model for each assignee slot based on task complexity — writes to the override map, still editable
board.showChildrenTitle: Expand every item that has a parent onto the board — top level of the work tree is shown by default
